Notes: No obligatory definite article in Neva.
Direction, infinitive and recipient are separate usages.
Inflect possessor rather than inserting a universal preposition.
Preposition, accusative in the current simplified grammar.
Determiner versus relative pronoun are distinct.
Subject may be omitted when clear.
Surface on/upon + accusative; not metaphorical on/about.
Similarity/manner only; role as, as if, and equal-degree as...as need additional syntax.
General do/place; some English 'do' is auxiliary with no direct equivalent.
Locative near/at + accusative; Neva at separately means but.
Genitive of so, not a universal possessive suffix.
Beside/around via ambi; means/instrument via kom. Passive agent by not implemented.
Speak is covered, but quote/report 'say/tell' needs dedicated usage.
Future marker, not English volitional noun/verb.
All/whole as agreeing adjective; unrestricted quantifier syntax untested.
Hypothetical result only: I would carry = Vela bero. Not habitual past/polite would.
Distal location, not existential there is/there are.
Consequential so/therefore expressed as for-that-reason. Neva so remains he/that.
'Above/over' is available; directional up needs specification.
Spatial out/outside + accusative; not every phrasal-verb out.
Spatial around via ambi; topic concerning via pro when context permits. Approximation not fixed.
Receive/obtain sense via existing deshen. Get + adjective, become, get to, etc. not generalized.
Interrogative; temporal subordinating when not yet defined.
Build/do cover narrower senses; no unrestricted make.
Ability modal; mago beren = I can carry. Epistemic can not encoded.
Enjoyment/affection uses luben; likeness/manner uses samo. Other syntax not generalized.
Abstract time/duration, neuter thematic noun; distinct from 'times' in arithmetic.
Answer particle (also ne = not in standard grammar).
Only/merely sense. Justice, exactly now, and recent-past just unresolved.
Recognize/know; more abstract knowledge in vidom.
Grasp/receive are narrower than general take.
Goal location: en + accusative; distinguish at-rest vs motion in context.
Adjective with gender and case endings.
Indefinite determiner as agreeing adjective; partitive and existential uses need care.
Past ability only (emago beren = I could carry). Polite request, epistemic and remote conditional uses unresolved.
At that time; logical therefore uses pro tod.
Independent exclusive particle; sentence scope may require contextual clarification.
Additive adverb, from Indo-European particle family.
Back/again as return adverb. Anatomical back requires separate noun.
Preposition after + accusative; temporal and spatial ordering.
Use/employ verb, transparent pro + dhen modern compound.
First ordinal adjective. Higher ordinals not fully frozen.
Emphatic even/indeed; scalar comparison and divisible-by-two sense not covered.
Adjective with regular gender and cases.
Finite causal clause connector; pro tod for 'because of that'.
Any as agreeing indefinite adjective; polarity/free-choice interpretation context-bound.
Superlative degree exists, generalized most/quantifier unresolved.
